title: RTI Application
description: An application under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act to obtain information or copies of records from any public authority, such as the status of your file, pension or complaint.
forum: Public Information Officer (PIO) of the public authority

fields.name: public_authority
fields.label: Public authority / department
fields.placeholder: e.g. Office of the District Treasury Officer

fields.name: subject_matter
fields.label: Subject matter
fields.placeholder: e.g. status of my pension application

fields.name: facts
fields.label: Information sought (one question per line)
fields.help: Ask for specific records: e.g. 'Certified copy of the file notings on my application no. 123 dated 01.04.2026'.

fields.name: fee_mode
fields.label: Application fee
options: Rs. 10 paid by Indian Postal Order
Rs. 10 paid in cash / court fee stamp
Exempt: applicant belongs to the Below Poverty Line category (copy of BPL card enclosed)

fields.name: delivery
fields.label: How do you want the information?
options: by post at the address given above
through inspection of records followed by copies

fields.name: life_liberty
fields.label: The information concerns someone's life or liberty (48-hour reply)

document.subject: Application under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 regarding {subject_matter}
intro: I, {applicant_name}, a citizen of India, request the following information under the Right to Information Act, 2005:

paragraphs.text: Period to which the information relates: {period}.

paragraphs: I request that the information be provided {delivery}. If any information is held by or more closely connected with another public authority, kindly transfer this application or the relevant part of it to that authority under Section 6(3) and inform me.

paragraphs.text: The information sought concerns the life or liberty of a person, and is therefore required to be provided within 48 hours under the proviso to Section 7(1) of the Act.

paragraphs: As required by Section 7(1), kindly provide the information within 30 days of receipt of this application. If the information is refused, kindly state the reasons, the provision relied upon, and the particulars of the First Appellate Authority, as required by Section 7(8).
closing: I state that the information sought does not fall within the exemptions under Sections 8 and 9 of the Act, to the best of my knowledge.
